List molecules reported in document CHEMBL1135903. Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Source: docs, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id, compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1135903'. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
